A little about me

Meet the artist.

Creativity is a journey of observing the little details and turning them into something meaningful.

DEVJIT ART · The Artist

Hello! I’m Devjit, the creator behind DEVJIT ART. I am a self-taught artist with 8 years of drawing experience, passionate about expressing ideas through traditional art and visual creativity.

I create artwork using graphite pencils, coloured pencils and watercolours, exploring different techniques and styles to bring each piece to life.

My thoughts on art: I believe every drawing has a story to tell. Art is more than putting lines and colours on paper — it is a way to express feelings, capture memories and see beauty in the smallest details. Every sketch teaches me something new, and I believe patience, practice and passion can turn a simple idea into something meaningful. My goal is to create artwork that connects with people and makes them feel something.

I also take commission work. If you have an idea for a custom artwork, feel free to get in touch with me.

My roots are in Purba Bardhaman, West Bengal, and I currently reside in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Thank you for visiting and being part of this creative journey.

⌖ Purba Bardhaman, West Bengal⌖ Currently in Jaipur, Rajasthan
